scientific_integrity: Unrestricted identities follow from explicit first-vertex conditioning and formal-power-series coefficient algebra, with exact finite checks as supplementary verification. Independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: A single endpoint chord of a path is analyzed. Known general examples already show edge addition may improve greedy occupancy; the new statement is the exact four-cycle-tail all-order law and positive sensitivity. No universal edge-addition comparison or independent historical-priority claim is made.
title: An exact four-cycle chord sensitivity law for random greedy independent sets
